about: Controls and service ordinals the inventory lets through (FR-040): each one no spec can work yet, and why. A control is `owner ROLE test-id` (or its name where it has no test id); an ordinal is `service ordinal N name`.

accepted.why: Its caller is Monitor's Devices tab (FR-034, from v0.5); nothing asks for the ACPI table list before then, and a spec standing in for that caller would prove nothing (a test is not a caller).
Worked by @login.restart and @login.shutdown (TASK-102), which restart or power off the machine: the inventory counts after them belong to the next boot, or to none.
Asked by conductor just before Shut down or Restart (@login.restart, @login.shutdown): the machine goes before the inventory reads the count. @login.restart proves it: the next mount needs no ffsck.
Its caller is vfs's snapshot, whose caller is Files (TASK-105); a spec standing in for that caller would prove nothing (a test is not a caller).
Its caller is Files (TASK-105): fstd::fs::snapshot has no other.
Its caller is Files and its copy engine (TASK-105, TASK-105A): fstd::fs::File::seek has no other yet.
Its caller is Files (TASK-105): fstd::fs::metadata has no other yet.
